title: Common definitions
description: Shared types for HexaBlock contracts (RN-COM-70, D-45, D-46, D-47).

gameId.description: Closed list of variants (SEC-API-06). Adding a variant adds a value here (EXTENSIBILITY.md).

levelGameId.description: Variants that are played by levels.

topology.description: Cell shape (RN-TOP-30). Progress, records and rankings are split by topology (D-27).

levelTopology.description: Topology of a level. 'any' is only valid for Hexa Sort levels without initial stacks (RN-COM-75).

cell.description: Address of one cell (D-47): [q, r] for hex, [x, y] for square and tri, [x, y, z] for cube. What the cell holds is described by the variant section. The validator checks that the length matches the topology.

color.description: Color token. The app maps each token to an accessible color for the theme.

displayName.description: Public name shown in the ranking (RN-COM-109). Unique, case-insensitive; 3 to 20 characters; letters (including accented Latin letters), digits, space, '_', '-' and '.'; no leading or trailing space.
